zc.recipes.cat.roupas.desc: Thread, fabric and what to wear so you do not freeze.
zc.recipes.cat.maquinas.desc: The first parts to mechanize the base.

zc.recipes.journal.landing: Everything I learn to make goes in here.$(br2)Recipes are on $(l)crumpled notes$() lost in houses, shops and bases. Repeats can be traded.
zc.recipes.flavor.primeiros_passos: $(o)Without tools you go nowhere. Flint hides in gravel, fiber comes from grass with a knife.$()$(br2)Knife first. Everything else comes from it.
zc.recipes.flavor.abrigo: $(o)A good base closes, lights up and feeds you.$()$(br2)Nails are gold: any iron nugget will do. Do not waste torches, light draws attention.
zc.recipes.flavor.saude: $(o)Dirty cloth gets infected. Boil the water, boil the cloth.$()$(br2)A deep cut needs stitches. A broken bone needs a splint, and rest.
zc.recipes.flavor.roupas: $(o)The cold kills slower than the dead, but it kills.$()$(br2)Torn clothes are mended with thread and a needle. Leather stops bites.
zc.recipes.flavor.equipamento: $(o)Carry more, go out less.$()$(br2)Gun parts only turn up in barracks and police stations. Do not waste them.
zc.recipes.flavor.maquinas: $(o)Water turns the wheel, the wheel turns the shaft, the shaft turns the rest.$()$(br2)With the press you make plates without hammering all day.
zc.recipes.proc.create.pressing.desc: Put the item on a $(l)Depot$() or a belt under a spinning $(l)Mechanical Press$(). One ingot becomes one sheet.
zc.recipes.proc.create.mixing.desc: Put the items in a $(l)Basin$() under a spinning $(l)Mechanical Mixer$(). Some mixes need a lit $(l)Blaze Burner$() under the basin.
zc.recipes.proc.create.compacting.desc: Items in a $(l)Basin$() under a $(l)Mechanical Press$(): the press packs them into a block or paste.
zc.recipes.proc.create.milling.desc: Drop the item into a spinning $(l)Millstone$() and wait for the powder or flour.
zc.recipes.proc.create.crushing.desc: Two $(l)Crushing Wheels$() spinning against each other. Drop the item on top: raw ore comes out crushed, with a chance of extra.
zc.recipes.proc.create.cutting.desc: Run the item on a belt or depot in front of an upward-facing $(l)Mechanical Saw$().
zc.recipes.proc.create.splashing.desc: An $(l)Encased Fan$() blowing through flowing water washes the items in front of it.
zc.recipes.proc.create.deploying.desc: A $(l)Deployer$() holding the second item uses it on the first one, on a depot or belt.
zc.recipes.proc.create.filling.desc: A $(l)Spout$() above a depot fills the item with the fluid from the tank behind it.
Hold the second item and right-click the block (the first item, already placed).
zc.recipes.proc.create.sequenced_assembl: Built in steps on a belt: press, deployer and spout, in the order of the items shown. Loop it until the part is done.
zc.recipes.proc.create.mechanical_crafti: Too big for the crafting table. Build a grid of linked $(l)Mechanical Crafters$(), put the items shown in each one and give it rotation.
zc.recipes.proc.create.sandpaper_polishi: Hold the sandpaper with the item in the other hand and use it: the item gets polished.
zc.recipes.proc.farmersdelight.cooking.d: Put the ingredients in the $(l)Cooking Pot$() on a lit stove or campfire. Some meals need a bowl or bottle to serve.
zc.recipes.proc.farmersdelight.cutting.d: Put the item on the $(l)Cutting Board$() and click it holding a knife (or the right tool).
zc.recipes.theme.create_forca.desc: Water wheels, windmills, shafts, cogs and gearboxes.
zc.recipes.theme.create_prensa.desc: Press, basin, mixer, burner and metal sheets.
zc.recipes.theme.create_producao.desc: Saw, drill, millstone, crushing wheels, fans, belts, funnels and pipes.
zc.recipes.theme.create_avancado.desc: Precision mechanism, mechanical arm, logistics and trains.
zc.recipes.theme.ferraria.desc: Tools, melee weapons, ingots and metal parts.
zc.recipes.theme.seguranca.desc: Keypads, cameras, keycards, reinforced blocks and traps.
zc.recipes.theme.marcenaria.desc: Doors, fences, stairs, windows and everything wooden.
zc.recipes.theme.construcao.desc: Bricks, stone, glass, concrete and finishes.
zc.recipes.theme.tecidos.desc: Wool, carpets, dyes, paper, leather and hammocks.
zc.recipes.theme.mecanica.desc: Parts and engines for cars, planes and gliders.
zc.recipes.theme.sobrevivencia.desc: Compass, map, binoculars, flashlight and other tricks.
